footer.newsletterText: Product and methodology notes, a few times a year.
footer.disclaimer: Matches are leads for human review and not legal determinations.
footer.sourcesText: Sanctions data from the U.S. Treasury OFAC lists. Entity data from Wikidata (CC0), GLEIF (open terms of use), and the ICIJ Offshore Leaks Database (ODbL, contents CC BY-SA). News metadata from GDELT.
footer.demoLabel: Demo environment. All customer and revenue figures are synthetic.

cookie.title: Cookies
cookie.text: This site uses only the cookies it needs to work, and stores your language choice. We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

login.title: Log in
login.mfaText: Enter the 6 digit code from your authenticator app.
login.setupText: Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6 digit code it shows.
login.saveCodes: Save these recovery codes. Each can be used once.
login.demoNotice: Demo environment. All tenants, subscriptions, and revenue figures are synthetic.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter your work email. If an account exists, we will send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If the account exists, a reset message has been sent.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password updated. You can now log in.
